title: DataScience TelemetryExportMergeReport

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the telemetry export merge analysis task. Produced a comprehensive quarterly operational performance report with statistical analysis, visualizations, and actionable recommendations. All deliverables created: report/report.md with 5 figures, analysis code in code/, and intermediate results in outputs/. Key findings: perfect data alignment between sources (100% match), consistent 3 kWh/day production increase across all units, 64.5% capacity utilization, and identified data quality issues in field collection (6.25% invalid records).
